summary: CheerTrack backend pytest suite executed against external preview URL. 22/22 tests passed (100%). Coverage: auth (signup/login/me + invalid token + duplicate email + wrong password), athletes CRUD, expenses categories (12) + CRUD + filter, payments CRUD, competitions CRUD (incl. housing_required, booking_release_at), bookings CRUD for hotel/car/flight + invalid type rejection, fundraisers CRUD, dashboard aggregate fields & values, reminders (4 kinds: expense, booking, booking_release, cancel_by), reminders sort by days_until, booking-with-zero-balance excluded, user-scoping (User B cannot read/patch/delete User A's athletes & competitions => 404), cascade deletes (athlete -> expenses+payments, competition -> bookings), and _id leak prevention across every response.

minor.issue: When Authorization header is absent, FastAPI HTTPBearer returns 403 (default auto_error). Spec/UX would normally expect 401 for missing token. Test accepts 401 or 403. Consider HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) and raising 401 explicitly for consistency with invalid-token case.

Pydantic EmailStr (email-validator) rejects reserved TLDs like .test/.example. /app/memory/test_credentials.md suggests parent@cheertrack.test which will 422. Recommend updating credentials doc to a non-reserved domain (e.g., @example.com is also reserved; use @mailinator.com or a real-looking domain) or disable special-use check via email_validator config.
JWT_SECRET default is 31 bytes -> pyjwt emits InsecureKeyLengthWarning. Set JWT_SECRET in backend/.env to >=32 bytes.

passlib bcrypt backend logs 'AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' at startup (passlib + bcrypt>=4 mismatch). Hashing/verifying still works but warning is noisy. Pin bcrypt<4.1 or upgrade passlib.

action_items: (Optional) Switch HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) and raise 401 when token missing for consistent unauthorized semantics.
(Optional) Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md – '@cheertrack.test' fails Pydantic EmailStr because .test is reserved. Use e.g. parent@mailinator.com.
(Optional) Set JWT_SECRET (>=32 chars) in /app/backend/.env to silence pyjwt InsecureKeyLengthWarning.
(Optional) Resolve passlib/bcrypt version warning (pin bcrypt<4.1 or upgrade passlib).
critical_code_review_comments: All Mongo queries correctly project {"_id": 0} – no ObjectID leakage observed across any endpoint.
User-scoping uniformly enforced via {id, user_id} filter on every read/update/delete – User B cannot access User A's data (returns 404 as expected).
Cascade deletes implemented: athlete delete removes expenses+payments; competition delete removes bookings. Verified end-to-end.
Rate limiting (slowapi 10/min) is applied to /auth/signup and /auth/login only – fine for now; consider for write endpoints later.

server.py is a single 818-line file with all routes; not yet at the 700-line guideline threshold by much. Consider splitting routers (auth, athletes, expenses, payments, competitions, bookings, fundraisers, dashboard, reminders) as the app grows.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own ephemeral users (prefix TEST_*@mailinator.com) and TEST_-prefixed athletes/expenses/competitions/etc. No production seed data modified. Some test data is left in Mongo (no global teardown) – safe due to unique UUIDs and TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green (22/22) at https://dynamic-repaint-v108.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_cheertrack_backend.py. Note that Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (.test/.example) so use @mailinator.com (or similar) for signup payloads. Backend lowercases email on signup/login – assert lowercase in responses. HTTPBearer returns 403 (not 401) when Authorization header is missing.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no functional bugs found. Initial test failures were test-side issues: (1) used .test TLD which email-validator rejects, and (2) compared response email against the original mixed-case input rather than the lowercased value backend stores. Both fixed in tests.
